# FitCheck AI

> FitCheck AI is a free Android app that gives friendly AI feedback on outfits, makeup and hair from a photo: an outfit score with notes on color, fit and balance. Outfit scoring is processed directly on your device; a few optional AI features (hairstyle previews, AI try-on, Premium diagnostics) send the chosen photo to a third-party AI service. An iPhone version is coming soon.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/): What FitCheck does and where to download it
- [How it works](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/how-it-works.html): The three steps, what the score looks at, limits and photo tips
- [About FitCheck](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/about/): What the app is for, what it does and does not do
- [AI outfit checker](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-outfit-checker/): Rate an outfit from a photo
- [AI makeup assistant](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-makeup-assistant/): Live camera makeup guidance
- [AI hairstyle try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-hairstyle-try-on/): Hairstyle and hair color ideas on your own photo
- [AI skin analysis](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-skin-analysis/): Cosmetic skin overview from the camera
- [Digital wardrobe](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/digital-wardrobe/): Save and organize favorite looks
- [Virtual outfit try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/virtual-outfit-try-on/): AI previews of you in different outfits
- [App comparisons](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/compare/): How FitCheck compares with other style apps
- [Best style apps compared](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/compare/best-style-apps/): Side-by-side comparison of five style and wardrobe apps, based on their Google Play listings
- [Style guides](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/): Practical outfit, color, makeup and hair guides

## Policies
- [Privacy policy](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/privacy.html): How photos, saved looks and Firebase are handled
